"Create a fully playable 2D pixel-art 3v3 ninja MOBA game inspired by Naruto.

GRAPHICS AND STYLE

- 2D top-down camera view.
- Small, colorful pixel-art characters, similar to classic top-down RPG games.
- Detailed pixel-art animations.
- Green grass, trees, rocks and village environments.
- Naruto-inspired visual design.
- Smooth movement and combat animations.
- Characters must be small on the screen, not large anime portraits or 3D models.

GAMEPLAY

- 3 versus 3 real-time battles.
- The player directly controls one hero.
- Virtual joystick on the left side of the screen.
- Attack and ability buttons on the right side.
- Two allied AI teammates.
- Three enemy AI-controlled heroes.
- Health bars and chakra bars.
- Each match should have a clear victory and defeat condition.
- Enemies should actively fight, chase and defend themselves.

CHARACTERS
Include Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, Kakashi, Itachi and other Naruto characters.

Each character must have:

- Unique pixel-art sprite.
- Unique basic attack.
- Three special abilities.
- Different attack animations.
- Different movement speed and combat statistics.

SPECIAL ABILITIES
Naruto:

- Shadow Clone Jutsu.
- Rasengan.
- Nine-Tails Chakra.

Sasuke:

- Chidori.
- Fire Style.
- Sharingan.

Sakura:

- Super Strength.
- Healing.
- Powerful Ground Punch.

Kakashi:

- Lightning Blade.
- Sharingan.
- Earth Style.

ARENA

- Create a large top-down pixel-art battlefield.
- Add trees, rocks, grass and destructible objects.
- Include obstacles that characters cannot walk through.
- Add a Naruto-inspired village map.

PROGRESSION

- Character selection screen.
- Unlockable heroes.
- Character levels.
- Different skins.
- Experience and rewards after battles.

IMPORTANT
Make this a real playable mobile game, not just a static image or visual demonstration.

Prioritize functional movement, combat, AI opponents and abilities before adding extra features.

Use portrait or landscape mobile layout depending on what works best for the gameplay.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a fully playable, mobile-friendly 2D pixel-art 3v3 ninja MOBA inspired by Naruto, prioritizing movement, combat, AI, and abilities.

## Requirements
- Include character selection, six Naruto-inspired heroes with unique attacks and three abilities, two allied AI, three enemy AI, health/chakra, victory/defeat, destructible obstacles, and progression/unlocks.
- Provide keyboard and mobile touch controls; make reasonable assumptions and do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Created a dependency-free vanilla HTML/CSS/Canvas game from scratch because the repository had no application source or framework.
- Used a landscape arena with a responsive mobile layout and hand-drawn pixel-art sprites and terrain.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added a character selection screen, hero roster, stat and ability panels, squad HUD, progression, XP rewards, and level-based unlocks persisted in localStorage.
- Implemented 3v3 real-time combat, player movement and attacks, allied/enemy AI, abilities, projectiles, health/chakra, collisions, destructible props, and match end conditions.
- Added WASD/arrow keys, Space/J attack, number keys for abilities, and mobile joystick/action buttons.
- Fixed initial deployment being disabled when the default hero was already selected.
- Verified `node --check game.js` and browser play: deployment works, the match timer advances, and using ability 1 consumes chakra.

### Active
- Review the latest battle screenshot and do a deeper gameplay/responsive check; address any issues found.

### Blocked

## Objective
- Build a fully playable, mobile-friendly 2D pixel-art 3v3 ninja MOBA inspired by Naruto, prioritizing movement, combat, AI, and abilities.

## Requirements
- Include six heroes with unique attacks and abilities, two allied AI, three enemy AI, health/chakra, match outcomes, destructible obstacles, and progression/unlocks.
- Support keyboard and mobile touch controls; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Built a dependency-free vanilla HTML/CSS/Canvas game because the repository had no application source or framework.
- Used a landscape arena, responsive layout, and hand-drawn pixel-art sprites and terrain.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented hero selection, squad HUD, progression and unlocks persisted in localStorage, 3v3 combat and AI, abilities, projectiles, collisions, and win/loss conditions.
- Added WASD/arrow keys, Space/J attack, number keys for abilities, and mobile joystick/action buttons.
- Made destructible props take hits from basic attacks and projectiles; added an inline favicon to avoid the missing favicon request.
- Verified `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`; captured desktop and mobile selection screenshots and reviewed layout.

### Active
- Do a deeper gameplay check, especially prop destruction, ability interactions, and match completion; mobile touch controls remain unverified in a live match.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test a live match through victory/defeat and exercise abilities and destructible props.
2. Confirm touch controls in a mobile-sized live match and check for browser console errors.
3. Report the game and any remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface, selection/result overlays, HUD, and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, heroes, combat, AI, abilities, input, destructible props, and progression.
- `style.css`: Desktop and mobile presentation.
- `/tmp/opencode/shinobi-battle.jpg`: Earlier gameplay screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/shinobi-desktop.png`: Recent desktop selection screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/shinobi-mobile.png`: Recent mobile selection screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are currently untracked.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The earlier browser test reported `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found)`; an inline favicon was added afterward, but the browser console has not been rechecked.

## Objective
- Build a fully playable, mobile-friendly 2D pixel-art 3v3 ninja MOBA inspired by Naruto, prioritizing movement, combat, AI, and abilities.

## Requirements
- Six heroes with unique attacks and abilities, two allied AI, three enemy AI, health/chakra, match outcomes, destructible obstacles, and progression/unlocks.
- Support keyboard and mobile touch controls; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use dependency-free vanilla HTML/CSS/Canvas because the repository had no application source or framework.
- Use a responsive landscape arena with hand-drawn pixel-art sprites and terrain.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented hero selection, squad HUD, progression and unlocks persisted in localStorage, 3v3 combat and AI, abilities, projectiles, collisions, and win/loss conditions.
- Added keyboard and touch controls, destructible props, and an inline favicon.
- Fixed AI target scanning so units pursue opponents across the arena instead of stopping when enemies are beyond 430 units.
- Passed `node --check game.js`, `git diff --check`, and browser gameplay checks for prop damage, abilities, victory/defeat outcomes, XP reward, mobile-layout controls, and movement.
- Browser checks reported no console or page errors; an actual 23-second battle ran without errors, and a 10-second diagnostic confirmed allied and enemy AI movement.

### Active
- Confirm match completion during a natural, uninterrupted match; assess player movement when obstacles are encountered.
- Verify controls using actual mobile touch input, beyond the emulated pointer drag.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run a longer natural match and confirm it reaches victory or defeat.
2. Check mobile controls with touch input in a live match and investigate any movement sticking.
3. Report remaining limitations and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Gameplay logic and AI pursuit fix.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Game interface, selection/result overlays, HUD, and touch controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Desktop and mobile presentation.

- `/tmp/opencode/live-match-check.mjs`: Natural-match browser smoke test.
- `/tmp/opencode/ai-diagnostic.mjs`: AI position diagnostic.

## Important Context
- The game files are uncommitted and currently untracked.
- A local server is running at `http://127.0.0.1:3002`.
- The 23-second natural match remained 3–3 with the player’s health unchanged; the AI diagnostic afterward showed allies and enemies had moved toward each other.

## Objective
- Build a fully playable, mobile-friendly 2D pixel-art 3v3 ninja MOBA inspired by Naruto, prioritizing movement, combat, AI, and abilities.

## Requirements
- Six heroes with unique attacks and abilities; two allied AI and three enemy AI; health, chakra, match outcomes, destructible obstacles, and progression/unlocks.
- Support keyboard and mobile touch controls; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use dependency-free vanilla HTML/CSS/Canvas because the repository had no application source or framework.
- Use a responsive landscape arena with hand-drawn pixel-art sprites and terrain.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented hero selection, squad HUD, progression/unlocks in localStorage, 3v3 combat and AI, abilities, projectiles, collisions, win/loss conditions, destructible props, keyboard/touch controls, and responsive presentation.
- Previous gameplay checks passed for prop damage, abilities, victory/defeat outcomes, XP reward, and mobile layout.
- Diagnosed natural-match AI blockage at the central village obstacle and actual mobile joystick pointer cancellation.
- Updated `game.js` AI movement with a top/bottom village detour waypoint; this latest change is not yet verified.

### Active
- Fix mobile joystick cancellation by adding `touch-action: none` to `.stick-zone` in `style.css`, then rerun the real-touch check.
- Verify AI detours allow engagements and a natural match to reach victory or defeat; investigate further if units remain stuck.
- Rerun syntax, diff, and browser gameplay checks after fixes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add `touch-action: none` to `.stick-zone` in `style.css`; rerun `/tmp/opencode/touch-live-check.mjs` and confirm sustained touch movement and skill activation.
2. Run an instrumented match to verify AI units cross the central village using the new route in `game.js`; fix route issues if necessary.
3. Run a longer natural match and confirm it reaches victory/defeat; then rerun existing checks and report results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay and the unverified AI waypoint detour.
- `style.css`: mobile joystick styling; touch cancellation fix remains pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/touch-live-check.mjs`: live-match touch input check.
- `/tmp/opencode/ai-touch-diagnostic.mjs`: captures touch events and AI positions.
- `/tmp/opencode/long-match-check.mjs`: natural-match smoke test.
- `/tmp/opencode/gameplay-check.mjs`: automated gameplay assertions.

## Important Context
- Game files are uncommitted and untracked.
- A 2-minute natural match remained live at 3–3; allies and enemies were stuck on opposite sides of the central village, whose solid props block direct paths.
- Real touch input triggered `pointercancel`; the joystick reset to zero, and the player moved only about 1.4 units during an 800 ms drag.
- `game.js` has just been edited to route cross-village AI via a top or bottom lane. No post-edit tests have been run yet.
